name: Praxeum Mechanic

weapons.name: Heavy hydrospanner
weapons.narrative_note: Not a weapon. A tool. The fact that it can crack a skull is incidental.

weapons.name: Hold-out blaster
weapons.narrative_note: Kept in a thigh holster under the coveralls. Luke does not approve. Luke also does not ask.

armor.name: Reinforced mechanic's coveralls
armor.narrative_note: Burn-resistant weave. Oil stains that will never come out. More pockets than strictly necessary.

tools.name: Comprehensive tool kit
tools.mechanical_effect: Enables Mechanics checks. Removes 1 setback die from repair attempts.
tools.narrative_note: Custom-organized case. Every tool in its place. Touch nothing.

tools.name: Diagnostic scanner with slicer module
tools.mechanical_effect: Adds 1 boost die to Computer checks for system diagnostics.
tools.narrative_note: Modified from Imperial surplus. Can read any standard protocol. The slicer module is not strictly legal.

tools.name: Two stimpacks
tools.mechanical_effect: Can heal 5 wounds per stimpack. Two uses before resupply needed.
tools.narrative_note: Stashed in the tool kit. Priorities.

special_items.name: Salvaged Imperial comm scanner
special_items.mechanical_effect: Once per act, a Computers check can intercept unencrypted Imperial military communications within system range.
special_items.narrative_note: Pulled from the Lambda shuttle's original comm suite before the conversion. The frequencies are still programmed.

throughline_question: What does loyalty cost when every allegiance demands a different piece of you?
voice_notes: Laconic, practical. Speaks in declarative sentences and workshop metaphors. Expresses affection through acts of service, not words. Uncomfortable with sincerity but incapable of dishonesty.
